commitResults.messageTitle: Rename main class and add greeting/exit messages
Refactor command parsing to use CommandType enum to replace if-else chain
Save and load tasks from storage file
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement automatic task persistence on the hard disk for Level 7.
* Add Storage class to handle reading from and writing to a local data file (data/penny.txt) using OS-independent relative paths.
* Add toFileFormat() across Task subclasses (Todo, Deadline, Event) to serialize tasks into pipe-delimited records.
* Load previously saved tasks when the chatbot starts up, gracefully handling missing files and corrupted lines.
* Automatically save the task list whenever tasks are added, marked, unmarked, or deleted.
* Reject '|' in task inputs to prevent storage file corruption.

Penny now recognizes date and time in the format of "dd/MM/yyyy HHmm"
for Deadline and Event tasks. The Task class has been updated to include
a new Time class that handles date and time parsing and formatting.

The Penny class has been modified to support the new date and time
features, allowing users to create tasks with specific deadlines and
event times.

User can now find tasks based on date and time, and the display of
tasks has been updated to show the date and time information in a
user-friendly format.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Ui class to handle user interactions
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract user interaction responsibilities from Penny into a new Ui class to improve Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) compliance.

* Create Ui class to manage standard input reading and console output formatting (welcome, goodbye, dividers, feedback, and errors).

* Update Penny to delegate user I/O and display formatting to Ui.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refine Storage with domain exception handling
commitResults.messageBody:
Wrap low-level I/O exceptions in PennyException to abstract storage failures and remove direct console printing from the Storage class.

* Wrap IOException and SecurityException in PennyException within load() and save() methods.

* Remove direct System.out printing in Storage to enforce separation of concerns.

* Update Penny to catch PennyException from Storage operations.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract Parser class to interpret user commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Extract command and argument parsing logic from Penny into a dedicated Parser class to separate input interpretation from application flow.

* Create Parser class to parse command types, task indices, todo, deadline, event arguments, and date query parameters.

* Update Penny to delegate all user input parsing to Parser.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadoc to all public classes and methods
Document and standardize codebase with JUnit tests
commitResults.messageBody:
The codebase lacks comprehensive Javadoc documentation, automated unit
tests, and strict adherence to the SE-EDU Java coding standard. This
makes the code harder to understand, test, and maintain as features
grow.

Let's,
* add Javadoc comments to all non-private classes, methods, and fields
* implement JUnit 5 test suites for Parser and TaskList
* refactor variable names, constants, and line wrappings to follow the
  SE-EDU Java coding standard (basic + intermediate)
* configure build.gradle with penny.Penny mainClass and shadowJar

Comprehensive unit tests and clean Javadocs ensure robust regression
testing and better code maintainability across all packages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command for keyword task searching
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot search for specific tasks by description keyword without
listing all tasks and inspecting them manually. This is inconvenient
when managing large task lists.

Let's,
* implement FindCommand to execute keyword task queries
* add findTasksByKeyword method to TaskList
* update Ui with showMatchingTasks method
* update Parser and CommandType to support 'find <keyword>'
* add unit tests in ParserTest and TaskListTest

Case-insensitive keyword searching allows users to quickly locate
relevant tasks across all task types.

Add checkstyle to project and fix all checkstyle issues in the codebase.
Add checkstyle configuration files to the config/checkstyle directory.
Update build.gradle to include checkstyle plugin and configure
it to use the checkstyle configuration files. Update codebase to comply
with checkstyle rules.

Change files with checkstyle issues.
